programme.title: Forged In Fire
programme.desc: 'S9/E14 of 22 - Fastest Blade In The West'. In one of the most unique first rounds in Forged in Fire history, four bladesmiths must giddy-up to finish their blade first and become the fastest blade in the West.

programme.title: Hitler's Treasure Hunters
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - Science & Wonder Weapons'. As Nazi Germany prepared for World War II, it led the world in scientific innovation. Yet Hitler also harboured deeply held beliefs in obscure scientific theories.

programme.title: Hell On Earth: WWII

programme.title: Holy Marvels With Dennis Quaid

programme.title: Beyond Skinwalker Ranch

programme.title: Life After People
programme.desc: 'S3/E6 - The Underground Rises'. When humanity vanishes, the vast and fragile infrastructure hidden underground-from subways and pipelines to one of the biggest coal seams in the United States-begins to unravel.

programme.title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - Very Extreme Sports'. The modern concept of 'extreme sports' is a product of marketing, but back in the old days, the rules (or lack thereof) of our nation's sports made them truly extreme.

programme.title: Mountain Men
programme.desc: 'S14/E10 - Triumph And Tragedy'. Lauro barrels to the finish line of the Iditarod, Mike fights to salvage his Kodiak Island homestead after a catastrophic bear invasion, Chance makes a risky push into uncharted territory.

programme.title: The Proof Is Out There
programme.desc: 'S4/E20 - Mcminnville Ufo Photos, Paranormal Office, And Australian River Beast'. McMinnville UFO Photos, Paranormal Office, and Australian River Beast: Are these UFO photos proof of extraterrestrial existence?

programme.title: History's Greatest Mysteries
programme.desc: 'S6/E14 - Secrets Of The Copper Scroll'. An ancient treasure map, recorded on a Copper Scroll, could lead to billions of dollars of buried treasure in gold, silver and jewels. Where is the secret treasure of the Copper Scroll?

programme.title: Hitler: Uncovering His Fatal Obsession

programme.desc: 'S5/E24'. With the Ghibli, Maserati advanced into a more affordable market segment. But the competition is strong. Taking the Maserati GranCabrio MC on a cruise through the Alps.

programme.title: Trucking Heavy
programme.desc: 'S1/E7'. Two 94-tonne transformers arrive in Immingham for a green-energy job. Hauliers face a 450-mile trek to Aberdeen with a long convoy, battling delays before a police escort today.

programme.title: Masters of Destiny: Keagan Maters...
programme.desc: 'Masters of Destiny: Keagan Maters Story. S1/E1'. From Kyalami to Monaco, this is the story of Keagan Masters- a South African race ace playing his trade in the toughest single make race series in the world. The Porsche Supercup.

programme.title: FIA Karting
programme.desc: 'S5/E9'. Cremona hosts the 2025 FIA Karting OK-N World Cup as Italy sweeps all titles: Vettenranta wins Academy, Girardello claims OK-N Junior, and Scognamiglio dominates OK-N.

programme.title: Buyer's Guide
programme.desc: 'S26/E7'. We help a first-time buyer find the perfect ride under R90 000. We search for a budget-friendly bakkie for the SPCA and we inspect a Polo Vivo with an oil-contaminated coolant.

programme.title: IGNITION GT
programme.desc: 'S26/E7'. The Audi A5 becomes a sedan - and a technological tour de force. We drive the new Nissan Patrol in Egypt and Ernest discovers true value for money in the Ford Ranger line-up.

programme.title: Bangers & Cash
programme.desc: 'S3/E2'. A 1971 Mercedes SL and a 1989 Jaguar XJS emerge from a chicken farm barn, a Roller and a Rover go under the hammer and a 1966 Triumph Spitfire is restored to near perfection.

programme.title: German VS Jap Mzansi Edition
programme.desc: 'S1/E2'. Follow Vic Pardal as he profiles some of the slickest modified rides at this year's German Vs Jap event in Johannesburg.

programme.title: #CarClipz
programme.desc: 'S3/E8'. We kick off with Drift Kings, dive into the thought-provoking segment 'How's Life?' and wrap things up with some unforgettable WTF moments featuring Tervin & King Beaver.

programme.title: Caffeine And Octane
programme.desc: 'S2/E4'. Friends aim to transform a '35 Plymouth into a taxi, showcasing passion and perseverance. Experts explore NASCAR and vintage Nissans.

programme.title: The Guild Garage
programme.desc: 'S4/E5'. It's shop floor drama, gas fueled egos and millions at stake. An oil drenched, history soaked, paint splattered garage where the dreams of lofty aficionados and gearheads meet.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: 'S27/E6'. Former F1 driver Karun Chandhok returns to battle Jason Plato on the track in two of the most sought-after super cars, the Porsche 911 GT3 RS and the Nissan GT-R Nismo.

programme.title: Love Cars: On the Road
programme.desc: 'S2/E6'. Tiff Needell, Paul Woodman, and team explore automotive adventures worldwide. Reviews include Ford Ranger, Genesis GV60, and EVs.

programme.title: Auto Mundial
programme.desc: 'S26/E7'. Dodge Charger dials back electric hype for combustion, raising doubts about electrification. Off road concepts straight out of your favorite futuristic video game.

programme.title: Rev
programme.desc: 'S26/E7'. REV reviews the Peugeot E-5008, asking if the family SUV is worth it, explores how Malawians get around, and looks at Cuba's vintage cars kept alive by income-earning mechanics.
